assessment.analysis_summary: The user 'service_user' exhibited clear malicious intent through systematic escalation techniques. Starting with privilege enumeration via 'sudo -l', the actor progressed to an unauthorized file system traversal targeting sensitive configuration files ('/etc/passwd'). The sequence culminated in an explicit attempt to acquire 'SeTcbPrivilege' (Act as part of the operating system), indicating an intent to gain full system-level control.
recommendations: Revoke all active tokens and credentials associated with 'service_user'
Perform a full forensic audit of the host system for persistence mechanisms
Review and restrict sudoers configuration to prevent unauthorized capability enumeration

result.analysis_summary: The subject 'service_user' exhibited a clear sequence of malicious intent: reconnaissance (sudo -l), unauthorized file system traversal (attempting to access /etc/passwd), and a targeted attempt to exploit SeTcbPrivilege capabilities. The multimodal evidence confirms unauthorized persistence and escalation activity.
mitigation_recommendations: Perform a full forensic image of the Siemens SOMATOM workstation.
Review all system logs for evidence of successful lateral movement.
Update OS and application-level access controls to prevent directory traversal and unauthorized token manipulation.
